July 4, 2019 marked 3 YEARS since #DelrawnSmall was murdered in cold blood by NYPD Officer Wayne Isaacs. We are demanding that @NYCMayor #FireWayneIsaacs, the NYPD officer that murdered Delrawn in front of his children and partner. #BlackLivesMatter

On July 2nd, we asked you to call Mayor DeBlasio and demand that he fire NYPD officer Wayne Isaacs immediately. TODAY, we're asking that you RT! @NYCMayor MUST #FireWayneIsaacs - the NYPD officer who murdered #DelrawnSmall and left him without aid! #BlackLivesMatter

#DelrawnSmall's family has been fighting for 3 years for discipline charges to be brought against the NYPD officer Wayne Isaacs who murdered Delrawn, lied about it & tried to cover it up. Today, we're demanding that @NYCMayor #FireWayneIsaacs immediately. 

#BlackLivesMatter

.@NYCMayor, no family should have to fear losing their loved one at the hands of those sworn to protect. It has been 3 years since #DelrawnSmall’s life was cut short. If you truly believe that #BlackLivesMatter, then you'll #FireWayneIsaacs immediately w/o pension!

.@NYCMayor, how can you say #BlackLivesMatter? 

Your inaction is sending a message to New Yorkers that the lives of #EricGarner and #DelrawnSmall do not matter at all to you. It has been 3 years since the murder of Small and Officer Isaacs is still on payroll. #FireWayneIsaacs!

Instead of calling an ambulance, Officer Isaacs called 911 w/ a false story of having been attacked w/o mentioning that he had just shot #DelrawnSmall who required immediate medical attention. 

If you truly believe #BlackLivesMatter, you'd #FireWayneIsaacs immediately @NYCMayor!
